description: Text highlighting with localStorage persistence. Inside <selection-menu> it renders a highlighter button + colour palette for the selection; standalone it renders no UI and exposes a JS API and events

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Standalone mode: ID of the element to annotate (defaults to the first child element). Ignored inside <selection-menu>, which highlights its own targets

attributes.name: colors
attributes.description: Comma-separated palette colour names; each needs a --highlight-{name} token

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Render stored highlights but disable creating new ones. Inside <selection-menu> no highlighter button is rendered

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: Custom storage key suffix (default: page pathname)

attributes.name: data-label-button
attributes.description: Accessible name of the highlighter button (selection-menu mode)

attributes.name: data-label-palette
attributes.description: Accessible name of the colour palette group (selection-menu mode)

attributes.name: data-label-annotation
attributes.description: Margin annotation text; forwarded to the target as data-highlights-label-annotation

attributes.name: data-label-added
attributes.description: Screen-reader announcement when a highlight is created; forwarded as data-highlights-label-added

attributes.name: data-label-removed
attributes.description: Screen-reader announcement when a highlight is removed; forwarded as data-highlights-label-removed

structure.description: Standalone mode: content to annotate (when not using for=)

methods.name: highlightSelection(color?)
methods.description: Highlight the current text selection in the given palette colour (default: last used). No-op when readonly or the colour is not in the palette

methods.name: getHighlights()
methods.description: Array of { id, startOffset, endOffset, text, color, note, created } records. Inside <selection-menu> the methods act on the most recently highlighted target (initially the first)

methods.name: clearAll()
methods.description: Remove every highlight on the target

methods.name: importHighlights(json)
methods.description: Replace the highlights from an exported string or object. Records with a bad shape, offsets outside the text or a colour not in the palette are dropped. Returns { imported, rejected }

events.name: highlights:added
events.description: A highlight was created. Dispatched on the target element and bubbles

events.name: highlights:removed
events.description: A highlight was removed via removeHighlight(). Dispatched on the target and bubbles

events.name: highlights:selected
events.description: Text was selected inside an interactive target — hook for a custom UI in standalone mode. Dispatched on the target and bubbles

events.name: highlights:clicked
events.description: An existing highlight or its margin annotation was clicked. Dispatched on the target and bubbles

events.name: highlights:note-changed
events.description: A note was saved (via <note-wc>). Dispatched on the target and bubbles

tokens.name: --highlight-ink
tokens.description: Text colour of highlighted text (light-dark() pair); per-colour override --highlight-{name}-ink
